title: Clade Read Counts
description: Read counts per taxonomic clade within a group, as produced by the DOWNSTREAM workflow. Each row represents a taxon with at least one read assigned to its clade (the taxon itself plus all descendants). Counts are provided both with and without deduplication. Only produced for short-read (Illumina/Aviti) platforms.

fields.name: group
fields.title: Group
fields.description: Group identifier assigned to this set of samples.

fields.name: taxid
fields.title: Taxon ID
fields.description: NCBI taxonomic ID for this row.

fields.name: parent_taxid
fields.title: Parent Taxon ID
fields.description: NCBI taxonomic ID of this taxon's parent in the taxonomy tree. Nodes without a parent in the taxonomy database default to 1 (root).

fields.name: reads_direct_total
fields.title: Direct Reads (Total)
fields.description: Number of reads directly assigned to this taxon by LCA, without deduplication. Counts only reads whose aligner_taxid_lca matches this taxon exactly, not descendants.

fields.name: reads_direct_dedup
fields.title: Direct Reads (Deduplicated)
fields.description: Number of reads directly assigned to this taxon by LCA (not descendants), after deduplication. Only counts reads that are their own exemplar under both duplicate-marking passes (seq_id == sim_dup_exemplar).

fields.name: reads_direct_exemplar_total
fields.title: Direct Reads (Total, Exemplar-Attributed)
fields.description: Number of reads directly assigned to this taxon by LCA (not descendants), without deduplication, attributing every read to the taxon of the exemplar representing it rather than to its own. Differs from reads_direct_total only where a duplicate group's members carry different LCA assignments. Provided so that reads_direct_dedup / reads_direct_exemplar_total is a duplicate rate over one coherent set of reads.

fields.name: reads_clade_total
fields.title: Clade Reads (Total)
fields.description: Number of reads assigned to this taxon's clade (this taxon plus all its descendants in the taxonomy tree), without deduplication. Rows are only included when this value is greater than 0.

fields.name: reads_clade_dedup
fields.title: Clade Reads (Deduplicated)
fields.description: Number of reads assigned to this taxon's clade (this taxon plus all its descendants), after deduplication. Only counts reads that are their own exemplar under both duplicate-marking passes (seq_id == sim_dup_exemplar).

fields.name: reads_clade_exemplar_total
fields.title: Clade Reads (Total, Exemplar-Attributed)
fields.description: Number of reads assigned to this taxon's clade (this taxon plus all its descendants), without deduplication, attributing every read to the taxon of the exemplar representing it rather than to its own. Differs from reads_clade_total only where a duplicate group's members carry different LCA assignments.
